MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 13
   C. 37
   D. 36

2. Solve for x: x + 3 = 8. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 3
   C. 6
   D. 8

3. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

4. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 121

5. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

6. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 16
   C. 0
   D. 8

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 9

8. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 13

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 5
   C. 1
   D. 7

10. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 7
   C. 14
   D. 49

11. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

12. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 26

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
